description: Route an inbound message to a read-only agent only when the model is confident the sender just wants information back. An example routing gate: READ at >= 0.9 routes, anything else goes to the full agent. The 0.9 is an example value, not a recommendation; calibrate your own.

instructions.question: What does the sender of `message.text` want done with it?
instructions.thread_rule: When `message.is_thread_reply` is true, read `thread.parent` first: a short reply usually answers what the parent asked.

READ.what: Asks for information or output to come back: a question, or a request to show, list, look up or send something.
READ.not_for: A report of work done, a status update, or a note to keep, however casually it is phrased.
examples: what is the status of order 1042
send me this week's open tickets

WRITE.what: Supplies something to record or change: a status, a note, a completed task, a record to open or close.
WRITE.not_for: A message whose only purpose is to get information back.

BOTH.what: Does both in one message: reports or changes something and also asks for something back.

rules.reason: A question from the assistant is still open, so this message may be its answer.
The model is confident the sender only wants information back.

default.reason: Not confidently read-only; the full agent handles it.

on_unavailable.reason: No answer from the model; the full agent handles it, as it would with no gate.
